quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that a doctor can see clearly using a special X-ray picture, not your skeleton!
quests.question: Bones
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are underneath your muscles and skin.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Bones are the hard parts inside your body that hold you up and give you shape!
quests.funFact: Drinking milk helps keep your bones strong and healthy.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that fills up when you eat a tasty snack -- but it is not your belly button!
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: It is below your chest, above your legs.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: Your tummy helps break down the food you eat into tiny pieces.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found where your fingers bend, along the back of your hand. It is also the one you might gently tap on a door to knock, but it is NOT your elbows!
quests.question: Knuckles
quests.hint: You see these bumps when you make a fist!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: Your knuckles are the joints that let your fingers curl into a fist!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the ticklish spot under your raised arm. It is also the one you keep clean and fresh with soap in the bath, but it is NOT your fingers!
quests.question: Armpits
quests.hint: They are right under your arms!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: Armpits can feel extra ticklish because the skin there is very sensitive!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that wrinkles up when you feel confused. It is NOT your nostrils!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the flat part above your eyebrows!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Your forehead can wrinkle up when you look surprised or confused.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we rest against a chair when we sit down. It is NOT your shoulder blade!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the part of you facing away from a mirror!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Your back has a strong row of bones running down the middle called your backbone.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that a dentist checks to keep healthy and strong, not your chin!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to bite and chew your food.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Your teeth start growing even before you are born, hidden under your gums!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you might wear a fun pair of socks. It is NOT your toenails!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are found where your foot meets your leg!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: Your ankles help you balance every time you stand on one foot!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the name for your arms and legs, all together. It is also the one that you stretch out wide when you do a jumping jack, but it is NOT your backbone!
quests.question: Limbs
quests.hint: Think about this: You have four of these in total.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Limbs are your arms and legs, working together as a team!
quests.funFact: You use your limbs to run, climb, swim, and reach for things.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part we use to say hello to a friend, not your nostrils!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It smiles when you are happy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Your lips and mouth work together every time you blow a big bubble with gum.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the name for the middle of your body, not counting your head, arms, or legs. It is also the one that includes your chest, tummy, and back all together, but it is NOT your tummy!
quests.question: Torso
quests.hint: Think about this: Your chest, tummy, and back are all part of it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Torso is the name for the middle of your body, made up of your chest, back, and tummy!
quests.funFact: Your torso holds many important parts, like your heart and lungs.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that sneezes loudly when it feels tickly, not your eyes!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is found between your eyes and your mouth.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Sneezing helps your nose clear away dust and germs.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that makes up your leg between your hip and your knee. It is also the one that helps you push hard when you pedal a bike, but it is NOT your kneecap!
quests.question: Thighs
quests.hint: Hint: They have some of the strongest muscles in your body.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Thighs are the part of your leg above your knees.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you bend when you sit criss-cross on the floor. It is NOT your heels!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the bendy part in the middle of your leg!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: Your knees are the biggest, strongest joints in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you blink to keep dust out of your eyes. It is NOT your teeth!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They flutter every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Eyelashes work like tiny fans, sweeping away dust from your eyes!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you flex to show off your strength, like a superhero -- but it is not your joints!
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: They are found under your skin.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Muscles get stronger every time you run, climb, or play.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits right above each of your eyes. It is NOT your teeth!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, right above your eyes!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Your eyebrows help keep sweat and rain out of your eyes!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you stomp on the ground when you feel excited, not your heels!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You have two, and you stand on them.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Most people's two feet are a tiny bit different in size from each other!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gets extra protection when you wear a real bike helmet. It is also the one that gives your head its round, bony shape, but it is NOT your brain!
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: It is the hard bone inside your head!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Your skull protects your brain the same way a helmet protects your head!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that swings side to side when you dance. It is also the one where your legs connect to the rest of your body, but it is NOT your torso!
quests.question: Hips
quests.hint: Hint: You put your hands on these like a superhero.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: You use your hips every time you take a big dance step.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you close tight when you play hide and seek, not your nostrils!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are found above your nose.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Your two eyes work as a team to help you judge how far away things are.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each toe. It is also the one that grows slowly, a little bit every month, but it is NOT your torso!
quests.question: Toenails
quests.hint: Hint: They help protect the tips of your toes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Keeping toenails trimmed helps your shoes feel comfortable.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you can count as hard, curved lines if you press gently on your chest. It is also the one found in your chest, curving from your backbone to the front, but it is NOT your skull!
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: They curve around your chest like a cage!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: Your ribs curve around your chest like a strong, protective cage!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that moves up and down when you chew your food. It is also the one found below your cheeks, holding your bottom teeth, but it is NOT your nose!
quests.question: Jaw
quests.hint: Hint: It opens wide when you yawn.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Only your jawbone can move; the rest of your skull stays still.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets you blow out all the candles on a birthday cake. It is also the one you use to blow up a balloon with one big breath, but it is NOT your limbs!
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: They fill with air when you breathe in!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Your lungs breathe in and out over twenty thousand times a day!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each finger. It is also the one that grows a little longer every single week, but it is NOT your arms!
quests.question: Fingernails
quests.hint: Hint: They help protect the tips of your fingers.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: It takes about six months to grow one fingernail from base to tip.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you use to feel cool sand at the beach, not your shins!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to help you balance.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Your toes help you steer and turn smoothly when you run around a corner.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you buckle your belt around your trousers. It is also the one that bends when you touch your toes, but it is NOT your hips!
quests.question: Waist
quests.hint: Hint: You spin a hula hoop around it.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: Your waist is where the top and bottom of your body meet.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that protects your eyes from bright sunshine and dust -- but it is not your eyelashes!
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: They shut tight when you sleep.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Eyelids close on their own when you sleep, without you even trying.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the bottom of your foot and touches the ground first. It is also the one that feels warm sand at the beach, but it is NOT your calves!
quests.question: Soles
quests.hint: Hint: They can feel very ticklish.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Walking barefoot on grass lets your soles feel every little tickle.
